title: fix(neo): wire Anthropic prompt cache_control breakpoints for parity …
body:
…with `amp --take-me-back`

The connector-local Neo inference path in src/server/neo-local-inference.ts was building Anthropic /v1/messages bodies with ZERO cache_control markers, so every turn of an Amp Neo agentic loop paid full input_tokens price (no cache_read_input_tokens). Reported symptom: ~10% of a Max-5x subscription consumed by a single "explain the codebase" prompt, versus less than 1% for the same prompt routed through `amp --take-me-back`.

Fix applies Anthropic's documented 3-of-4 cache-breakpoint pattern (https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/prompt-caching):

  1. Top-level cache_control: {type: "ephemeral"} - automatic caching for the growing message history (sliding breakpoint placed by Anthropic on the latest user/tool_result block every turn).
  2. Explicit cache_control on the LAST tool definition - tools array cached as one segment across the conversation.
  3. Explicit cache_control on the LAST system block - covers [billing, identity, systemPrompt] after injectClaudeCodeSystem prepends the billing header and Claude Code identity.

Also adds a defensive ensureSystemCacheBreakpoint in providers/anthropic.ts::injectClaudeCodeSystem so the legacy take-me-back path (and any future upstream that forgets to mark its system blocks) still gets at least the system prefix cached. Honours the "billing header must stay un-marked" invariant - the defensive marker only ever lands on the array tail (identity or last upstream system block), never on the billing line.

Files:
  - src/providers/anthropic.ts (+56): ensureSystemCacheBreakpoint helper + refactored injectClaudeCodeSystem.
  - src/server/neo-local-inference.ts (+82): exported buildAnthropicInferenceBody + buildCachedAnthropicTools helper; inferAnthropic now delegates body construction to the builder.
  - tests/forward.test.ts (+286, 9 new tests): cache_control wiring (preserve / defensive / never-on-billing / top-level / on tools) plus 3 end-to-end pipeline tests covering the full buildAnthropicInferenceBody -> parseBody -> prepareAnthropicBody flow.
  - tests/neo-local-runtime.test.ts (+92, 8 new tests): direct unit tests for the body builder including 3-of-4-slot accounting, empty-tools handling, and byte-stability across identical turns.

Verification:
  - 165 / 165 tests pass (bun run test), including 17 new tests.
  - bun x tsc --noEmit clean.
  - Connector already sends "prompt-caching-scope-2026-01-05" beta header (constants.ts:55) so the cache markers are honored by api.anthropic.com.

Expected runtime behavior: first turn shows
cache_creation_input_tokens > 0; turns 2..N show cache_read_input_tokens growing, input_tokens staying small - matching the take-me-back baseline.
